Don’t these cards have a history that can be checked? Please check it and see whether it was previously assigned to my floor or not.

This card has not been working since day one. I noticed it from the beginning, but I was busy moving and settling into the apartment, so I didn’t report it immediately.

I’ve been telling you about these issues for month . Please stop making excuses and fix the card issue and the water leakage once and for all.
